title: French Catholic Church prepares for Pope Leo's historic visit in September
subhead: Pope Leo XIV will travel to Paris, Lourdes and Metz from September 25 to 28, marking the first formal papal visit to France in nearly 20 years.

Gaza authorities recover another 112 bodies buried under rubble
subhead: After more than two years of Israeli strikes, authorities in Gaza continue to recover human remains buried under rubble, twisted metal and destroyed concrete. Thousands of people's remains are still unaccounted for in Gaza, many of them similarly believed to be buried under rubble after intense Israeli air strikes.

title: Democrats seek to win back blue-collar workers ahead of Pennsylvania's midterm elections
subhead: In the 7th District of the battleground state of Pennsylvania, Democrats are trying to convince a working-class population that feels abandoned by the Trump administration to vote for them.

title: Trump slams prosecutor for dismissing Reflecting Pool case
subhead: The US president's plans to renovate Washington's Reflecting Pool this summer created a national drama after a botched installation led to rapid algae growth. Although Trump repeatedly claimed that vandals were responsible, federal prosecutor Jeanine Pirro rejected the accusation, leading the president to publicly lash out on Saturday.

title: Drought causes a 'collapse' in vegetable production: 'Even with irrigation, young plants have not survived'
subhead: Cauliflower, peas and lettuce are suffering from a lack of water and successive heatwaves. The industry describes the situation as a 'disaster,' especially across western France, as the ability to sow crops for future seasons is also being hampered.

subhead: For nine days, Bordeaux's departmental operations center has coordinated management of the megafire in the Gironde department, which has ravaged 42,000 hectares.
